entries.what: First Monday back on the three-night pattern after the go-live month; Thao wakes mid-afternoon, packs rice and makes her cà phê sữa đá thermos, then takes the shuttle up Ortega Hill for a 7 p.m. shift on 4 West.
entries.outcome: Night ran steadily with a normal load; Jasmine noted the quieter unit.

entries.what: Tomás left for his apprentice day before she woke; she noticed the Indigenous Peoples' Day quiet with schools closed and families heading to the marsh park.
entries.outcome: Brief text exchange, no walk this time.

entries.what: Finished the Monday-night shift, slept 8:30 to 3 with blackout curtains and the box fan, then ran Tuesday grocery errands at Ruiz Family Market.
With Linh's anatomy lab practical on Oct 17 and midterms underway, Thao asked the assistant for a list of lab practical study tricks to forward to Linh.
entries.outcome: Sent Linh the short list by text.

entries.what: Worked her Tuesday night shift on 4 West, eating leftover rice at 2 a.m.
Came home after the night shift, slept through the morning and let another Hạnh voicemail go unanswered.
Wednesday off: did laundry at the card-only room at Marisol Gardens and reloaded the card.
Texted Linh a good-luck note as midterms began and checked she was eating lunch.
entries.outcome: Linh replied with a thumbs up.

entries.what: Thursday off: walked the Ulloa marsh boardwalk loop in the afternoon.
entries.outcome: Good stretch of daylight and quiet.

entries.what: Evening at home with Tomás; he made a huge pot of chili and left it soaking.
Fell asleep to the baking show, earplugs in against Theo's crying through the wall.
Friday: slept the afternoon, then went in for her 7 p.m. night shift on 4 West, and heard that Greg Holloway has started at St. Anselm on charting support.
entries.outcome: Greg now supports the new charting system at the hospital.

entries.what: Linh's lab practical day; Thao thought of her on break and texted for news.
Noemi's coworker Victor became acting IT desk lead at Ridgeline, which Greg mentioned while stopping by the unit.
Saturday morning after a Friday night, went to phở tái at Phở Bến Thành with Jasmine.
entries.outcome: Good breakfast and gossip about the vote.

entries.what: Slept 10 to 4 and spent the evening on the balcony with the pothos and the struggling basil.
Cooked eggs and rice with Tomás and agreed to split dishes loosely.
Sunday: Hạnh asked again whether Linh is set on pharmacy, so Thao asked the assistant to draft a message deflecting the question on Linh's behalf.
entries.outcome: Sent a soft deflection to Hạnh.

entries.what: Prepped for her Monday night shift, packed rice and made her thermos.
A quiet evening with Tomás, who left his boots by the door.
